title: Data & AI Specialist
description:
Finance Data & AI Specialist - Python & SQL

Location: Central London
Sector: Technology
Contract: Initial contract - Outside IR35
Day Rate: Competitive, dependent on experience
Start Date: ASAP - Immediate or short-notice candidates preferred

Altum Consulting are partnering with an innovative, fast-growing technology business in Central London that is looking to appoint a highly technical finance professional with advanced Python and SQL capabilities.

Working closely with Finance, Data and Technology stakeholders, you will combine financial expertise with strong technical skills to develop practical solutions that improve data accessibility, reporting capabilities and operational efficiency.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-thinking organisation where you will play an instrumental role in developing its AI capabilities, enhancing financial data processes and delivering intelligent, technology-driven solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Apply advanced Python and SQL skills to develop and enhance financial data solutions, reporting tools and automated workflows.
  • Play a key role in building and developing AI capabilities across the finance function and wider organisation.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve financial analysis, reporting and decision-making.
  • Design, develop and maintain robust data models, scripts and automated processes.
  • Work with complex financial datasets to deliver meaningful insights and support commercial decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Data and Technology teams to develop and implement practical technical solutions.
  • Support the integration, extraction and manipulation of financial data across multiple systems and platforms.
  • Explore the application of generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation within finance-related activities.
  • Ensure the accuracy, reliability and integrity of financial data and associated technical solutions.
  • Provide technical expertise and recommendations to support the organisation's evolving AI capabilities.


You'll be/have:

  • Advanced, hands-on expertise in Python and SQL
  • Proven experience developing technical solutions, automating workflows and working with complex financial datasets.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting, accounting principles and finance operations.
  • Ability to translate financial requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical, hands-on approach.
  • Confident working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating independently within a fast-paced technology environment.


Highly Desirable:

  • Experience developing or implementing AI-enabled solutions.
  • Exposure to generative AI, large language models (LLMs) or machine learning applications.
  • Experience working within a technology business, scale-up or data-driven organisation.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, APIs and data pipelines.
  • Experience developing financial analytics tools, predictive models or intelligent reporting solutions.


This is an opportunity to combine financial expertise with advanced programming skills in a business that is investing in the development of its AI capabilities. You will have the opportunity to work on technically challenging projects, collaborate with experienced stakeholders and directly contribute to the development of innovative solutions.

For further information please contact Jen McMurray on the attached details. Candidates will be considered immediately for interview and start.
